votes.motion: Approve the Conservation Restriction to North County Land Trust Inc. and certify it at a public meeting held June 21, 2011, pursuant to MGL Chapter 14, Section 52.
votes.quote: tom motioned to certify that at a public meeting duly held on june 21, 2011 the board of selectmen approve the foregoing conservation restriction

votes.motion: Approve holding a special town meeting on Monday July 18, opening the warrant that evening and closing it June 24 at 12:00 noon.
votes.quote: tom move that the board approve holding a special town meeting on monday july 18

votes.motion: Appoint DPW Director Jack Rodriquenz to the Survey Board in lieu of the Town Surveyor.
votes.quote: ernie motioned to appoint the dpw director, jack rodriquenz to serve on the survey board in lieu of town surveyor, tom seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Ratify the FY'2012 Town Manager appointments/re-appointments as recommended, with the exception of the Technical Advisory Committee.
votes.quote: paula motion to ratify the appointments as recommended by the town manager with the exception of the technical advisory committee, tom seconded, voted unanimously to approve.

votes.motion: Approve the Town Counsel arrangement with Kopelman & Paige, which continues at rates reduced by $5.00 per hour (subject inferred from surrounding discussion; motion text says only 'to approve').
votes.quote: tom move to approve, paula seconded, voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Adjourn the Regular Session at 9:15 P.M.
votes.quote: being no further business board voted unanimously to adjourn regular session at 9:15 p.m.
